title: ConfirmRequest
description: Optional body of confirm. The payment is applied only by the confirm that turns the hold into a reservation. Same key + different body = 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

reference.description: Opaque id of the one simulated payment that covers the whole basket, chosen by the consumer.

amount.description: Must equal the hold's totalPrice, else 400 INVALID_PAYMENT. Simulated: no money moves.
